description: Quality gates fmt-check diff around 'use bitty_ipc_api::error::IpcError' plus unresolved crate::error path in bitty-ipc-auth test code (E0433 on all platforms, surfaced loudest on Windows). PeerCredentials::new/VerifiedPeer::attested were cfg(test)-gated to bitty-ipc-auth's own test binary only, so downstream crates (bitty-ipc-devtools, bitty-ipc) referencing them from their own tests failed to compile. Fix: correct the ErrorClass path to bitty_ipc_api::error::ErrorClass, add a test-support feature to bitty-ipc-auth gating these constructors, wire dev-dependencies with that feature in bitty-ipc-devtools and bitty-ipc, run cargo fmt --all. No public API removed or renamed; ServeContext::with_granted/with_granted_session/issue_automation_bearer and the bitty-ipc test-support feature stay intact for the bitty core pin at 6841646.
title: Fix main CI: rustfmt diff + Windows E0433 in bitty-ipc-auth
